$comment: Public bool Require* properties on *Options types that are allowed (#146). Peer-acceptance rules belong in NetworkPolicy, driven by on-chain activations (#145); list a property here only if it is node-local, with the reason. Changes need CODEOWNERS review.

allowed.reason: Node-local: whether this storage node demands signed calls from registered members (#140). It is advertised as storage.rpc.auth.v1 and does not decide which peers a gateway accepts.

Node-local: whether this storage node's own /ready waits for its region to be verified (BlobStorage #1 FR-25). It changes only what the node reports to its load balancer or orchestrator, never which peers anyone accepts.
